title: "1)nutrients"

```{r}

# Packages

library(tidyverse)
library(readxl)
library(janitor)
library(stringr)
library(vegan)
library(effsize)
library(broom)
library(patchwork)
library(lme4)
library(lmerTest)
library(broom.mixed)
library(scales)

set.seed(1)
```

```{r}

# 1) Import and clean

Nutrients_all <- read_excel("Dataset_Nutrients_EmysOrbicularis_Meyer.xlsx")

to_numeric_comma <- function(x) {
  x <- as.character(x)
  x <- str_replace_all(x, ",", ".")
  suppressWarnings(as.numeric(x))
}

df_2024 <- Nutrients_all %>%
  clean_names() %>%
  mutate(across(everything(), ~ ifelse(.x == "NA", NA, .x))) %>%
  mutate(
    sample_type  = factor(sample_type),
    season       = factor(season),
    nesting_site = factor(nesting_site),
    landuse      = factor(landuse)
  )


meta_vars <- c(
  "slbez", "sample_type", "season", "nesting_site", "landuse",
  "nest_depth", "total_egg_number", "egg_number_hatched",
  "egg_number_undeveloped", "failure_unknowncause",
  "dead_embryos_hatchlings_nest", "living_hatchlings_nest",
  "hatching_rate", "emergence_rate"
)

meta_vars <- intersect(meta_vars, names(df_2024))
nutrient_vars_raw <- setdiff(names(df_2024), meta_vars)

df_2024 <- df_2024 %>%
  mutate(across(all_of(nutrient_vars_raw), to_numeric_comma))
```

```{r}

# 2) Aggregate fractions to total nutrient variables


df_2024 <- df_2024 %>%
  mutate(
    p_euf = ifelse(
      is.na(p1) & is.na(p2),
      NA,
      rowSums(across(c(p1, p2)), na.rm = TRUE)
    ),
    k_euf = ifelse(
      is.na(k1) & is.na(k2),
      NA,
      rowSums(across(c(k1, k2)), na.rm = TRUE)
    ),
    ca_euf = ifelse(
      is.na(ca1) & is.na(ca2),
      NA,
      rowSums(across(c(ca1, ca2)), na.rm = TRUE)
    ),
    mg_euf = ifelse(
      is.na(mg1) & is.na(mg2),
      NA,
      rowSums(across(c(mg1, mg2)), na.rm = TRUE)
    ),
    bor_euf = ifelse(
      is.na(bor1) & is.na(bor2),
      NA,
      rowSums(across(c(bor1, bor2)), na.rm = TRUE)
    ),
    s_icp = ifelse(
      is.na(s_icp1) & is.na(s_icp2),
      NA,
      rowSums(across(c(s_icp1, s_icp2)), na.rm = TRUE)
    ),
    p_icp = ifelse(
      is.na(p_icp1) & is.na(p_icp2),
      NA,
      rowSums(across(c(p_icp1, p_icp2)), na.rm = TRUE)
    )
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    p_total = ifelse(
      is.na(p_euf) & is.na(p_icp),
      NA,
      rowSums(across(c(p_euf, p_icp)), na.rm = TRUE)
    )
  )
```


```{r}
# ============================================================
# 3) Labels, variable groups, and plot style
# ============================================================

#pal_main <- c(
#  "control" = "#074F57",
#  "nest"    = "#698050"
#)


pal_main <- c(
  "control" = "#053B45",
  "nest"    = "#B8AA50"
)



theme_pub <- theme_classic() +
  theme(
    plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5, size = 17, face = "bold"),
    plot.subtitle = element_text(hjust = 0.5, size = 11),
    legend.position = "right",
    legend.title = element_blank(),
    axis.line = element_line(colour = "black"),
    panel.grid.major = element_blank(),
    panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
    panel.border = element_blank(),
    text = element_text(colour = "black", size = 13),
    axis.text = element_text(colour = "black", size = 11),
    axis.title = element_text(size = 13, face = "bold"),
    strip.background = element_blank(),
    strip.text = element_text(face = "bold", size = 12)
  )

nutrient_labels <- c(
  p_total = "Phosphorus",
  k_euf   = "Potassium",
  ca_euf  = "Calcium",
  mg_euf  = "Magnesium",
  bor_euf = "Boron",
  na      = "Sodium",
  s_icp   = "Sulfur",
  no3_de  = "Nitrate nitrogen",
  norg_de = "Organic nitrogen",
  fe3     = "Iron",
  mn3     = "Manganese",
  zn3     = "Zinc",
  cu3     = "Copper"
)

nutrient_units <- c(
  p_total = "mg/100g",
  k_euf   = "mg/100g",
  ca_euf  = "mg/100g",
  mg_euf  = "mg/100g",
  na      = "mg/100g",
  s_icp   = "mg/100g",
  no3_de  = "mg/100g",
  norg_de = "mg/100g",
  bor_euf = "mg/1000g",
  fe3     = "mg/1000g",
  mn3     = "mg/1000g",
  zn3     = "mg/1000g",
  cu3     = "mg/1000g"
)

macro_vars <- c(
  "p_total",
  "k_euf",
  "ca_euf",
  "mg_euf",
  "na",
  "s_icp",
  "no3_de",
  "norg_de"
)

micro_vars <- c(
  "bor_euf",
  "fe3",
  "mn3",
  "zn3",
  "cu3"
)

macro_vars <- intersect(macro_vars, names(df_2024))
micro_vars <- intersect(micro_vars, names(df_2024))

get_unit_label <- function(var) {
  if (var %in% micro_vars) {
    "mg/1000g"
  } else {
    "mg/100g"
  }
}


# Helper: significance stars from p-values


p_to_stars <- function(p) {
  case_when(
    is.na(p) ~ "",
    p <= 0.001 ~ "***",
    p <= 0.01  ~ "**",
    p <= 0.05  ~ "*",
    TRUE ~ ""
  )
}
```


```{r}

# 4) Analysis dataset


dat_nc <- df_2024 %>%
  filter(sample_type %in% c("control", "nest")) %>%
  mutate(sample_type = factor(sample_type, levels = c("control", "nest")))

table(dat_nc$sample_type)
length(unique(dat_nc$nesting_site))
```

```{r}

# 5A) Macronutrients: PCA + blocked PERMANOVA + dispersion


dat_macro <- dat_nc %>%
  select(sample_type, nesting_site, all_of(macro_vars))

cc_macro <- complete.cases(dat_macro[, c("sample_type", "nesting_site", macro_vars)])
dat_macro <- dat_macro[cc_macro, ]

X_macro <- dat_macro %>%
  select(all_of(macro_vars)) %>%
  mutate(across(everything(), log1p)) %>%
  as.matrix()

X_macro <- X_macro[, apply(X_macro, 2, sd, na.rm = TRUE) > 0, drop = FALSE]
macro_used <- colnames(X_macro)

X_macro_scaled <- scale(X_macro)

pca_macro <- prcomp(X_macro_scaled, center = FALSE, scale. = FALSE)

scores_macro <- as.data.frame(pca_macro$x[, 1:2]) %>%
  rownames_to_column("sample_id") %>%
  mutate(
    sample_type = dat_macro$sample_type,
    nesting_site = dat_macro$nesting_site
  )

macro_var_expl <- summary(pca_macro)$importance[2, 1:2] * 100

perm_macro <- how(nperm = 999)
setBlocks(perm_macro) <- dat_macro$nesting_site

dist_macro <- dist(X_macro_scaled, method = "euclidean")

adonis_macro <- adonis2(
  dist_macro ~ sample_type,
  data = dat_macro,
  permutations = perm_macro
)

disp_macro <- betadisper(dist_macro, group = dat_macro$sample_type)
disp_macro_test <- permutest(disp_macro, permutations = perm_macro)

adonis_macro
disp_macro_test

p_macro_pca <- ggplot(scores_macro, aes(x = PC1, y = PC2)) +
  stat_ellipse(
    aes(colour = sample_type),
    geom = "path",
    linewidth = 1.2,
    type = "norm"
  ) +
  geom_point(
    aes(colour = sample_type),
    size = 5.2,
    alpha = 0.70
  ) +
  scale_colour_manual(values = pal_main) +
  labs(
    title = "Macronutrients",
    x = paste0("PC1 (", round(macro_var_expl[1], 1), "%)"),
    y = paste0("PC2 (", round(macro_var_expl[2], 1), "%)"),
    tag = "A"
  ) +
  theme_pub +
  theme(
    plot.tag = element_text(face = "bold", size = 16),
    plot.tag.position = c(0.02, 0.98)
  )
p_macro_pca
```

```{r}

# 7A) Macronutrients: site-adjusted exploratory follow-up models


results_macro <- map_dfr(macro_used, function(v) {
  
  dat_sub <- dat_nc %>%
    select(sample_type, nesting_site, all_of(v)) %>%
    drop_na()
  
  fit <- lm(
    as.formula(paste0("log1p(", v, ") ~ sample_type + nesting_site")),
    data = dat_sub
  )
  
  broom::tidy(fit) %>%
    filter(term == "sample_typenest") %>%
    mutate(
      nutrient = v,
      nutrient_label = recode(v, !!!nutrient_labels, .default = v),
      median_control = median(dat_sub[[v]][dat_sub$sample_type == "control"], na.rm = TRUE),
      median_nest = median(dat_sub[[v]][dat_sub$sample_type == "nest"], na.rm = TRUE)
    )
})

results_macro <- results_macro %>%
  mutate(
    p_adj_bh = p.adjust(p.value, method = "BH"),
    direction = case_when(
      estimate > 0 ~ "higher_in_nest",
      estimate < 0 ~ "lower_in_nest",
      TRUE ~ "no_difference"
    )
  ) %>%
  arrange(p.value)

results_macro
```

```{r}

# 8) Figure 2: top nutrients
# raw concentrations with units


top_macro <- results_macro %>%
  slice_head(n = min(4, nrow(results_macro))) %>%
  pull(nutrient)

top_micro <- results_micro %>%
  slice_head(n = min(4, nrow(results_micro))) %>%
  pull(nutrient)

plot_list_macro <- map(top_macro, function(v) {
  
  this_title <- recode(v, !!!nutrient_labels, .default = v)
  this_unit  <- nutrient_units[[v]]
  
  this_p <- results_macro %>%
    filter(nutrient == v) %>%
    pull(p_adj_bh)
  
  this_star <- p_to_stars(this_p)
  
  y_max <- max(dat_nc[[v]], na.rm = TRUE)
  y_min <- min(dat_nc[[v]], na.rm = TRUE)
  y_pos <- y_max + 0.08 * (y_max - y_min)
  
  ggplot(dat_nc, aes(x = sample_type, y = .data[[v]], colour = sample_type)) +
    geom_boxplot(
      aes(group = sample_type),
      width = 0.52,
      fill = "white",
      linewidth = 1.0,
      outlier.shape = NA
    ) +
    geom_jitter(
      width = 0.08,
      size = 4.0,
      alpha = 0.70
    ) +
    annotate(
      "text",
      x = 1.5,
      y = y_pos,
      label = this_star,
      size = 6,
      fontface = "bold"
    ) +
    scale_colour_manual(values = pal_main) +
    scale_y_continuous(expand = expansion(mult = c(0.05, 0.18))) +
    labs(
      title = this_title,
      x = NULL,
      y = this_unit
    ) +
    theme_pub +
    theme(
      legend.position = "none",
      plot.title = element_text(size = 12.5, face = "bold", hjust = 0.5),
      axis.text.x = element_text(size = 10),
      axis.title.y = element_text(size = 11)
    )
})

plot_list_micro <- map(top_micro, function(v) {
  
  this_title <- recode(v, !!!nutrient_labels, .default = v)
  this_unit  <- nutrient_units[[v]]
  
  this_p <- results_micro %>%
    filter(nutrient == v) %>%
    pull(p_adj_bh)
  
  this_star <- p_to_stars(this_p)
  
  y_max <- max(dat_nc[[v]], na.rm = TRUE)
  y_min <- min(dat_nc[[v]], na.rm = TRUE)
  y_pos <- y_max + 0.08 * (y_max - y_min)
  
  ggplot(dat_nc, aes(x = sample_type, y = .data[[v]], colour = sample_type)) +
    geom_boxplot(
      aes(group = sample_type),
      width = 0.52,
      fill = "white",
      linewidth = 1.0,
      outlier.shape = NA
    ) +
    geom_jitter(
      width = 0.08,
      size = 4.0,
      alpha = 0.70
    ) +
    annotate(
      "text",
      x = 1.5,
      y = y_pos,
      label = this_star,
      size = 6,
      fontface = "bold"
    ) +
    scale_colour_manual(values = pal_main) +
    scale_y_continuous(expand = expansion(mult = c(0.05, 0.18))) +
    labs(
      title = this_title,
      x = NULL,
      y = this_unit
    ) +
    theme_pub +
    theme(
      legend.position = "none",
      plot.title = element_text(size = 12.5, face = "bold", hjust = 0.5),
      axis.text.x = element_text(size = 10),
      axis.title.y = element_text(size = 11)
    )
})

p_top_macro <- wrap_plots(plot_list_macro, ncol = 2)
p_top_micro <- wrap_plots(plot_list_micro, ncol = 2)

# Die 2x2-Blöcke als je ein Panel behandeln und taggen
p_top_macro_panel <- wrap_elements(full = p_top_macro) +
  labs(tag = "B") +
  theme(
    plot.tag = element_text(face = "bold", size = 16),
    plot.tag.position = c(0.02, 0.98)
  )

p_top_micro_panel <- wrap_elements(full = p_top_micro) +
  labs(tag = "D") +
  theme(
    plot.tag = element_text(face = "bold", size = 16),
    plot.tag.position = c(0.02, 0.98)
  )

p_top_panels <- p_top_macro_panel | p_top_micro_panel

p_top_panels


p_final <- p_pca_panels / p_top_panels +
  plot_layout(heights = c(1.0, 1.25))

p_final
```

```{r}
# Supplementary figure: all measured nutrients
# Macronutrients above micronutrients
# BH-adjusted significance stars as in Figure 1


get_bh_star <- function(v, results_tbl) {
  
  this_p <- results_tbl %>%
    filter(nutrient == v) %>%
    pull(p_adj_bh)
  
  if (length(this_p) == 0) return("")
  
  p_to_stars(this_p[1])
}

make_section_title <- function(title_text) {
  ggplot() +
    annotate(
      "text",
      x = 0.5,
      y = 0.5,
      label = title_text,
      fontface = "bold",
      size = 6
    ) +
    xlim(0, 1) +
    ylim(0, 1) +
    theme_void()
}

make_nutrient_plot <- function(v, results_tbl) {
  
  this_title <- recode(v, !!!nutrient_labels, .default = v)
  this_unit  <- nutrient_units[[v]]
  this_star  <- get_bh_star(v, results_tbl)
  
  y_max <- max(dat_nc[[v]], na.rm = TRUE)
  y_min <- min(dat_nc[[v]], na.rm = TRUE)
  y_range <- y_max - y_min
  
  if (is.na(y_range) || y_range == 0) {
    y_pos <- y_max * 1.08
  } else {
    y_pos <- y_max + 0.08 * y_range
  }
  
  p <- ggplot(dat_nc, aes(x = sample_type, y = .data[[v]], colour = sample_type)) +
    geom_boxplot(
      aes(group = sample_type),
      width = 0.52,
      fill = "white",
      linewidth = 1.0,
      outlier.shape = NA
    ) +
    geom_jitter(
      width = 0.08,
      size = 4.0,
      alpha = 0.70
    ) +
    scale_colour_manual(values = pal_main) +
    scale_y_continuous(expand = expansion(mult = c(0.05, 0.20))) +
    labs(
      title = this_title,
      x = NULL,
      y = this_unit
    ) +
    theme_pub +
    theme(
      legend.position = "none",
      plot.title = element_text(size = 12, face = "bold", hjust = 0.5),
      axis.text.x = element_text(size = 10),
      axis.title.y = element_text(size = 10),
      plot.margin = margin(5, 5, 5, 5)
    )
  
  if (this_star != "") {
    p <- p +
      annotate(
        "text",
        x = 1.5,
        y = y_pos,
        label = this_star,
        size = 6,
        fontface = "bold"
      )
  }
  
  p
}

plot_list_macro_all <- map(macro_vars, function(v) {
  make_nutrient_plot(v, results_macro)
})

plot_list_micro_all <- map(micro_vars, function(v) {
  make_nutrient_plot(v, results_micro)
})

p_macro_title <- make_section_title("Macronutrients")
p_micro_title <- make_section_title("Micronutrients")

p_macro_all <- wrap_plots(plot_list_macro_all, ncol = 3)
p_micro_all <- wrap_plots(plot_list_micro_all, ncol = 3)

p_supplement <- p_macro_title / p_macro_all / p_micro_title / p_micro_all +
  plot_layout(heights = c(0.12, 1.45, 0.12, 1))

p_supplement

```

```{r}

# Correlation heatmap of macro- and micronutrients

library(tidyverse)
library(pheatmap)
library(grid)


# 1) Data


nutrient_vars <- intersect(c(macro_vars, micro_vars), names(dat_nc))

dat_corr <- dat_nc %>%
  select(all_of(nutrient_vars)) %>%
  mutate(across(everything(), as.numeric)) %>%
  drop_na() %>%
  mutate(across(everything(), log1p))

heat_cols <- colorRampPalette(c(
  "#224A6D",
  "#FFFFFF",
  "#EF436B"
))(100)


# 2) Correlation matrix


cor_mat <- cor(dat_corr, method = "spearman", use = "pairwise.complete.obs")


# 3) P-value matrix


cor_pmat <- matrix(NA_real_, ncol = ncol(dat_corr), nrow = ncol(dat_corr))
colnames(cor_pmat) <- colnames(dat_corr)
rownames(cor_pmat) <- colnames(dat_corr)

for (i in seq_len(ncol(dat_corr))) {
  for (j in seq_len(ncol(dat_corr))) {
    cor_pmat[i, j] <- suppressWarnings(
      cor.test(dat_corr[[i]], dat_corr[[j]], method = "spearman", exact = FALSE)$p.value
    )
  }
}


# 4) Significance labels


sig_labels <- matrix("", nrow = nrow(cor_pmat), ncol = ncol(cor_pmat))
sig_labels[cor_pmat < 0.05] <- "*"
sig_labels[cor_pmat < 0.01] <- "**"
sig_labels[cor_pmat < 0.001] <- "***"
diag(sig_labels) <- ""


# 5) Pretty labels


pretty_names <- nutrient_labels[colnames(cor_mat)]

colnames(cor_mat) <- pretty_names
rownames(cor_mat) <- pretty_names
colnames(sig_labels) <- pretty_names
rownames(sig_labels) <- pretty_names


# 6) Plot to Viewer / RMarkdown

pheatmap(
  cor_mat,
  color = heat_cols,
  breaks = seq(-1, 1, length.out = 101),
  border_color = NA,
  clustering_distance_rows = "euclidean",
  clustering_distance_cols = "euclidean",
  clustering_method = "complete",
  display_numbers = sig_labels,
  number_color = "black",
  fontsize = 10,
  fontsize_number = 9,
  main = "Spearman correlation among soil nutrients"
)


# 7) Save as PDF

pheatmap(
  cor_mat,
  color = heat_cols,
  breaks = seq(-1, 1, length.out = 101),
  border_color = NA,
  clustering_distance_rows = "euclidean",
  clustering_distance_cols = "euclidean",
  clustering_method = "complete",
  display_numbers = sig_labels,
  number_color = "black",
  fontsize = 10,
  fontsize_number = 9,
  main = "Spearman correlation among soil nutrients",
  filename = "Supplementary_Figure_nutrient_correlation_heatmap.pdf",
  width = 7,
  height = 6
)


# Save heatmap as PNG for Word


pheatmap(
  cor_mat,
  color = heat_cols,
  breaks = seq(-1, 1, length.out = 101),
  border_color = NA,
  clustering_distance_rows = "euclidean",
  clustering_distance_cols = "euclidean",
  clustering_method = "complete",
  display_numbers = sig_labels,
  number_color = "black",
  fontsize = 10,
  fontsize_number = 9,
  main = "Spearman correlation among soil nutrients",
  filename = "Supplementary_Figure_nutrient_correlation_heatmap.png",
  width = 7,
  height = 6
)
```
